hubTrigger.claim: Shanghai aluminium reached nearly a four-year high after fresh China capacity cuts.
Illegal aluminium-capacity shutdowns were large enough to materially reshape national supply and the A-share aluminium sector had already rallied strongly.

candidate.name: 中国铝业

companyEvidence.claim: H1 revenue about RMB91.3bn, +83%; attributable profit RMB751m, roughly +10x; company attributed the improvement mainly to higher alumina and primary aluminium prices.
Management said H1 primary aluminium output increased by about 250kt while competitors cut capacity, giving the company direct volume exposure to the higher-price environment.

materialityCase: The earnings improvement is economically large but arises from the company's already-core aluminium/alumina profit pool.
Supply-side reform and aluminium repricing were already the dominant market narrative before the H1 result.
This is therefore the archetypal known-cycle control rather than an emerging profit pool.

controls.name: 云铝股份
controls.role: integrated aluminium control with H1 attributable profit +187.7%
